independence.statement: Reviewer fetched report 11930 markdown fresh from GET /api/v1/tensor/reports/11930 and read only that markdown plus the upstream wp-11930-01 asset manifest. No producer explanation, chat log, commit message or upstream narrative was consulted; the reviewer did not read the producer's scripts beyond their registration entries.
limitations: The TensorDEM checkout (module, scripts, test suite, records.jsonl, artifacts report.json) is not present in this repository, so DEM physics, the 42-item pytest suite, the 747-task campaign, the NSGA-II run and the KE/work gate were NOT re-executed.
Six figure PNGs were byte-hashed against the manifest hashes but NOT visually compared against their caption claims.

Mathematics was re-derived from the numbers printed in the report, so any mistake shared between the report text and the underlying pipeline would not be caught by this review (no primary-source model audit).

scope: semantic fidelity of every recomputable number in the report (geometry, packing, Jacobian spectrum/cond/rank, correlation matrix, Brun index, Weibull power-law holdout, AC4b protocol refinement, AC5 stress-ratio deviations, AC6/AC7 percentages)
internal consistency of tables, verdicts and cross-references
claim–evidence binding and severity of overstatements
upstream asset-registration fidelity (hash, locators, counts, figure bytes)

findings.scope: §3.2 AC2 diagnostic: Brun collinearity index of the worst parameter pair
findings.finding: Published γ=6.71 for pair ['k_c','k_p'] is not reproducible from the published correlation ρ=0.978 under either standard definition: Brun γ=1/√(1−R²)=4.796, Belsley 2-column index √((1+ρ)/(1−ρ))=9.486. Only the non-standard 1/√(1−ρ)=6.745 lands near 6.71, which suggests a missing square / undeclared formula. The report never states the γ formula, so the 'worst pair' ranking is not independently auditable.

evidence_locator.quote: 最坏参数对 ['k_c', 'k_p']：Brun γ = 6.71，相关系数 0.978；全 6 列 γ = inf

findings.reproduction: verify_wp-11930-04.py N2.5: ρ recomputed from the published Jacobian JᵀJ (0.97802) → γ_brun=4.796, γ_belsley=9.486, 1/√(1−ρ)=6.745.
findings.impact: Does not change the structural conclusion: J has rank 3/6 (recomputed N2.3) and any column is exactly representable by the others → γ=inf for the full 6-column set (recomputed N2.6).
findings.remedy: State the Brun formula in the report (and in the code docstring) and republish γ for the pair; if the 1/√(1−ρ) form was used, fix the implementation.

findings.scope: §3.4 AC4 table column '局部 m' and the direction-consistency sentence
findings.finding: The '局部 m' column reports 0.080 (t=0.05) and 0.045 (t=0.80), i.e. 3–4 orders of magnitude below the global m=262.976 fitted in the same paragraph. If read literally as Weibull moduli, the local values contradict the global fit and would falsify AC4; the numbers are only consistent with the local exponent 1/m (→ m≈12.5 / 22.2). The label/quantity is wrong or at least ambiguous, while AC4 PASS hinges on 'end m direction consistency'.
findings.impact: Direction consistency is a sign test on the local exponent, so the AC4 verdict survives; but a reader comparing 0.080 to 263 would conclude catastrophic heterogeneity that the report does not discuss.
findings.remedy: Rename the column to 'local exponent 1/m (local m in brackets)' or publish local m = 12.5 / 22.2 and explain the difference from the global fit.

findings.scope: §5 error table, Brazilian centre stress-ratio row
findings.finding: The same row states a 9.8% relative difference and then qualifies it as '差两个量级' (two orders of magnitude). 9.8% (and even the worst configuration, 788%) is not a two-order-of-magnitude gap; the qualitative clause contradicts the quantitative cell it annotates.

evidence_locator.quote: | 巴西中心主应力比 | Hondros −3.0（解析）| 最优 -2.705（相对 9.8%）| 否（差两个量级，honest FAIL）|

findings.reproduction: verify_wp-11930-04.py N4.1 recomputes all six AC5 deviations (9.8/16.0/39.3/130.2/205.2/788.1%); none is 10².
findings.impact: Wording only; the honest FAIL verdict and §3.5 robustness FAIL are unaffected.
findings.remedy: Delete or correct the '差两个量级' clause (e.g. '定性不符：多配置下中心横向拉应力缺失').

findings.scope: §2 method item 7 (negative control) vs §3.6 measured result
findings.finding: The method text says the 200-random-θ control 'verifies that random parameters can hardly land in the literature band', but the measured violation ratio is 83.5%, i.e. 33/200 ≈ 16.5% (about one in six) random parameter sets DO land in [5,15] MPa. That is the opposite of 'almost impossible' and is precisely why AC6 is recorded FAIL.

evidence_locator.quote: 200 组随机 θ 只跑 UCS（AC6，验证“随机参数几乎不可能落进文献带”）

result_locator.quote: 违反比例 83.5%（n = 200；UCS 中位 2.546 MPa）

findings.impact: The FAIL is honestly recorded, but the method paragraph overstates the control's strength; downstream readers may cite the control as evidence the band is discriminative, which it is not.
findings.remedy: Rewrite §2 item 7 to 'quantifies how often random θ lands in the band (16.5%, n=200) — the control FAILED its ≥95% target'.

findings.finding: H/D=2.000 mixes endpoints: H=0.2 m is the gauge (8 lattice spacings, centre-to-centre of the driven end layers) while D=0.1 m is the bounding-box diameter (3 spacings + 2 radii). Under uniform conventions the same lattice gives H/D=2.25 (extent/extent, still inside ASTM [1.5,2.5]) or 2.667 (centre-to-centre/centre-to-centre, outside the band). The convention is not stated, so the AC1 PASS is convention-dependent.

evidence_locator.quote: UCS 试件：H/D = 2.000（ASTM D7012 带 [1.5, 2.5]）→ PASS，颗粒数 144

findings.impact: Verdict survives under the physical convention (2.25 ∈ [1.5,2.5]) but not under a pure centre-to-centre convention (2.667).
findings.remedy: State the convention explicitly and report both numbers (physical 2.25, gauge/D 2.00).

findings.scope: §3.3/§3.4 numbers that cannot be re-derived from the report text
findings.finding: The fitted-thickness tensile strengths (t=0.1/0.2/0.4, the fit inputs) are never printed, so the published σc/σt=2.688 and m=262.976 cannot be recomputed from the report alone; only the two holdout predictions are reproducible from the published (m, σ_ref). The three-target feasibility matrix (AC3) therefore contains one number (2.688) with no in-report derivation.

findings.reproduction: verify_wp-11930-04.py N3.1/N3.2 reproduce 0.3753 MPa and 0.3713 MPa at t=0.05/0.80 from (m, σ_ref); N8.1 records the missing fit inputs.
findings.impact: Fidelity of the holdout chain recomputes clean; the ratio target's provenance is not.
findings.remedy: Add the five-thickness σ_t table (fit inputs + repeats) to §3.4.

findings.finding: 'relative difference 0.000' is asserted from two values printed to three significant figures (1.01e+06 Pa each); the displayed evidence cannot support an exact-zero claim (it only bounds the difference by ~1e-3 relative).

findings.reproduction: Reading of the published precision; not a numerical contradiction.
